title: Ulyana and the Orchard
author: Gideon Thackeray
blurb: Rosalind Voss, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
